FOUNDER

Rev. Dr. Sola Abraham Olayinka

Rev. Dr. Sola Abraham Olayinka is an ordained minister of God, raised for end-time warfare against the enemy of the home. The Lord is using him for all, married and single, for the joy of marriage.

He is happily married to Pastor (Mrs) Florence Kehinde Olayinka. The union is blessed with children.

His ministry interest is in marriage, discipleship and leadership training. He is available to help churches, families and individuals in these areas.

“A healthy marriage is not built on surveillance or concealment, but on truth, wisdom, respect and Christ-like love.”

Pastor Sola’s message is simple: your past does not have to define your marriage. Choose forgiveness, release the pain, learn the lessons, and let Christ give you a new story.

Pastor Sola
